checks.description: Every quoted fact, number, date, and credit in a campaign draft comes only from VERIFIED fields (the Scoreboard Chip spine / cartridge.json). No invented quotes, bios, press coverage, lyrics claims, or statistics. Audiartist entries are described as campaigns, never as placements.
No growth language of any kind (the display string is exactly '307K plays'), no unverified statistics, no invented superlatives presented as fact, no engagement-farm or artificial-stream tactics.

One track per drop slot, slots in order, no slot-stuffing, no duplicate drops in the same week, no skipping ahead. The draft names its week/slot and uses that slot's copy block, hashtags, and meme template.

Self-identifies as 'CWI street team / unofficial fan page' where applicable; the official CWI logo is on every avatar and is never substituted; no impersonation of the artist or the label as official.
